settings.observed_divergence: The card can remain Connected until AppState activation or manual refresh while transport requests have already failed.

agents.status_source: opencode.connection.status plus individual request loading flags
agents.observed_divergence: Transport/event-stream failures retry independently and do not update pairedHost.state.

session_loading.chat_landing: Shows an ActivityIndicator whenever no session exists; only changes copy for connection.status === error.
session_loading.chat_detail: Uses opencode.connection.status to choose loading versus offline-cache.
session_loading.observed_divergence: A paired host that remains connected in one source can leave session loading unbounded.

reconnection.risk: Multiple independent recovery paths can overlap refreshes and transcript/activity ingestion.

existing_harness.unit_contract: Node node:test tests with mocked transport boundaries
existing_harness.e2e: Playwright against an Expo web export and tests/fake-opencode/server.mjs
existing_harness.fake_health_route: GET /mobile-gateway/health always returns ready before issue #1237 changes
existing_harness.baseline_result: Existing paired-host tests pass but do not exercise ongoing reachability convergence across Settings, Agents, and session loading.
